verdict.rationale: Clara documents registrable webhook subscriptions: you supply a callback URL, the transaction statuses you care about, and a signing secret, and Clara POSTs HMAC-SHA256-signed events to your endpoint. The sandbox supports webhook subscriptions and on-demand test events isolated from production. Missing for 10: evidence of event types beyond transaction statuses, documented production retry/delivery guarantees (the sandbox explicitly makes one attempt with no retries), independent or hands-on corroboration.
